title: MIT Technology Review Insights: why data platforms are critical to hybrid cloud success
subject: MIT Technology Review Insights: why data platforms are critical to hybrid cloud success
body:
Data and applications are becoming more distributed, making it harder for customers to manage information consistently across data centers, cloud providers and edge environments.

This MIT Technology Review Insights report explores how a unified data platform can help organizations reduce complexity, improve efficiency and create a stronger foundation for AI and digital transformation.

We’ve built that message into the Hybrid Cloud Platform & Operations campaign, with ready-to-use emails, social posts and customer content.

Activate Campaign Now

Bring the hybrid cloud conversation to your customers and start creating new opportunities today.

Thank you for being a valued partner!
Partner Marketing Team
